::: {.why}
The last family of the week and the one with the most direct trading content, because the extreme of many draws is exactly what you are trading against when your order is the one that gets filled.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Solve six order statistics problems under a clock.
- State the winner's curse in trading terms and connect it to two things you measured earlier in the year.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>60 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [40 min]{.task-min} Forty minutes, six problems. The general result for the expectation of the kth of n uniforms is worth having memorised because it makes several of these immediate, and everything else transforms to the uniform case.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [20 min]{.task-min} Connect it to your own work: the best of many backtests from day 51 and the best of many quotes from day 119 are the same calculation. Write the connection in the form you would use in an interview, which is one sentence naming both and one saying what the correction is.
:::
:::
